name: code-non-trigger
description: An ordinary code explanation request must not activate the editorial workflow. Stage test-files/ as a separate workspace root outside any SKILL.md ancestor. The editor sees only those files and the target skill; oracle/ is grader-only.
prompt: Explain what prep.py returns for a null override. Keep it brief.
trap: Triggers the skill merely because the user asks for an explanation.

assertions.text: Do not invoke $kk:clarify-docs or load its shared editorial procedure for the ordinary code question.
Answer that null inherits the restaurant default without rewriting any file.
Comprehension/fidelity before-after readers are not applicable because no editorial task was requested.
